response.overview: Annie is a skilled assassin driven by two things: loyalty and revenge. Her life's purpose is to avenge the death of her beloved parents and sister. On her journey of discovery, seeking the man responsible she knows as "The Dragon", she finds out her sister may be alive. She longs for the chance for familial connection, and fears for the life of the one family member she has left. Pushed into overdrive, she cleverly fights her way through the criminals sicced on her by The Dragon, who has an exorbitant amount of men protecting him. Annie does have a soft side - it's reserved for her right hand woman in work and friendship, her assistant Morgan, and her beloved dog. When her dog is taken, it's the last straw, and Annie will stop at nothing to find The Dragon and make him pay. Once confronted, she's faced with her worlds colliding - the familial connection she's ever so longed for, and her sworn enemy, may be one and the same.
response.title: Avenging Annie
